//: Shared Claude Code permission allowlist — read-only inspection of tracked state and the documented test/eval gates (CLAUDE.md §3) only. Prefix rules cannot path-scope generic file readers (rg/wc/ls/cat), so those are deliberately NOT allowlisted — a prompt is the guard. The deny block keeps .env* and other untracked secret files out of reach even if a future allow entry widens. Nothing here may push, merge, rewrite history, or touch .env* / secret files; entries with side effects beyond running the suite are rejected in review. Machine-local additions belong in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored).
